caption: The drawing depicts a section of woven textile composed of intersecting horizontal and vertical bands in a grid-like pattern, primarily using red, blue, brown, white, and gray colors. The vertical bands alternate between solid and patterned areas, with the leftmost bands showing brown and red stripes, some patterned with small white shapes, while the adjacent bands contain blue and white stepped motifs. The horizontal bands reflect similar colors and patterns: the topmost bands combine blue, white, and brown, while the central and lower bands include red and brown geometric designs. The woven structure is tightly packed in the upper left quadrant, becoming looser toward the bottom and right edges where the threads unravel into long fringes. These fringes extend outward from the composition in red, blue, white, and gray, with the colors of the fringe corresponding to the woven areas they border. The name "MAGNUS S. FOSSUM" is printed below the woven textile illustration.
title: Woven Coverlet (Detail)
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
